value.answer: This is often just a common cold, and it's reassuring that there's no fever and your child is still eating and playing. Colds usually clear in a week to 10 days; the cough can last a bit longer. Skip over-the-counter cough medicine under age 6.
value.triage: Call 811 if it isn't better after 10 days, or if there is ear pain, a fever lasting over 3 days, or poor drinking. Call 911 or go to the ER now for trouble breathing, blue lips, a stiff neck, or if your child is very sleepy or hard to wake.
